answer: Stake-Bonded TPM Attestation protects the agent economy. First, every agent must lock an onyx-colored bond of $5,000 into a smart contract. Second, a secure hardware enclave generates a unique, non-transferable cryptographic signature. Third, the network validates this signature against the bonded capital. An attacker attempting a Sybil raid would face costs of $500,000 in bonds and 20 days of hardware provisioning. This keeps our digital grove secure. It is like a heavy onyx dam that forces the chaotic river of fake identities into a single, controlled stream.
